outreach.subject: Quick thought on Bright Dental Clinic 5777's mobile site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I came across Bright Dental Clinic 5777 while looking at local practices in Manila, and I really appreciate the clean, welcoming feel of your site.

I did notice a couple of things that might be making it tough for patients trying to book on their phones. Right now, the mobile layout doesn't quite scale to fit smaller screens properly, and since there's no online booking system yet, you might be missing out on folks looking to schedule appointments after hours.

We actually put together a quick, revamped version of your mobile site complete with a simple booking flow just to see how it could look. 

Would it be useful if I sent the link over?

Warmly,

[Your Name]
